verdict.rationale: Trello is a SaaS platform with a developer ecosystem, so the question of whether it publishes agent-oriented docs applies. Direct probes found no llms.txt at developer.atlassian.com, no markdown docs variant for the Trello developer pages, and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. The 'MCP server — Connect Trello to any AI tool' mention concerns a server integration, not agent-readable documentation, so it is not credited here.
